method: Nonblind manual review of all v2 original records against selected inputs. Each item is one annotated finding; categories may overlap, and grouping is a reviewer choice. These counts are not independent observations or a gold standard.

findings.detail: Susan's records quote Daniel's sentence although their claims concern Susan.
Daniel's independent contribution is not recorded.
The old friendship/support memory does not assert that the current job supports well-being.
The new career claim is linked to unrelated friendship/support units.
An affirmative friend memory is labelled negation.
The intention to find another job is omitted as a claim.
lately on thinking about career and comparative negation on insufficient job support are not bound.

human_judgment.detail: The new support statement does not explicitly assert a friendship; whether it supports that relationship is a judgment.
